tested_object: One Actor/Critic checkpoint trained by a frozen interleaved Task-A-positive then Task-B-positive update schedule, evaluated for simultaneous retention of both controlled abilities across the final task switch

research_series_policy.rationale: VS-C R3 confirmed Task A and Task B under separate task-specific learner instances; canonical authority explicitly states that R3 did not establish one checkpoint simultaneously holding both abilities, multitask coexistence, retention, or continuing-account composition.
research_series_policy.if_pass: promote only single-checkpoint synthetic dual-task composition to a later separately preregistered controlled integration experiment
research_series_policy.if_fail: do not rescue schedule/budget/gates under R0; open a new identity only for a new composition hypothesis

adaptations_made_after_exposure: VS-E composition claim selected because current authority records that VS-C R3 used separate task-specific training instances and did not establish one-checkpoint coexistence

claims.tested_object: A single interleaved OnPolicyLearner checkpoint with exact R3 authority/optimizer and fresh seeds

claim_scope.schedule: 256 cycles; Task A update then Task B update in every cycle; 512 total learner generations
claim_scope.positive_arm: Task A positive relation + Task B true delayed consequence
claim_scope.control_arm: Task A account-observation zero relation + Task B shuffled action-to-consequence relation
claim_scope.evaluation: true Task A and true Task B environments at PRE, after final A update, and after final B update

estimand.gate: both reused R3 final aggregate gates pass; positive joint pass count >=7/8 at both final-switch checkpoints; control joint pass count <=1/8 at both checkpoints

claims.estimator: Eight fresh paired seeds; one positive and one dual-control learner per seed from bitwise-identical initialization; frozen deterministic adapter evaluation
claims.replication_unit: paired learner seed; task batches and trajectories within a seed are not independent scientific replicates
validity_prerequisites: exact R3 authority, optimizer, Task A, Task B, and per-task gate semantics
fresh seeds do not overlap R0-R3 seed sets
positive/control learners start bitwise-identically per seed
single learner instance receives both task updates without reset or parameter copy between tasks
global generation id increases monotonically across all 512 updates
credible_alternatives: PASS establishes only coexistence for these two synthetic tasks and schedule, not continuing-account historical learning
FAIL may be schedule/interference/capacity specific and does not falsify the whole learner family
R3 separate-task confirmation remains valid regardless of VS-E outcome
direction entropy coefficient 0.005 is inherited for comparability and is not promoted to production authority
authority_scope: may qualify one-checkpoint coexistence of the exact two controlled abilities under the frozen interleaved schedule
may permit a later controlled integration/composition experiment

composition_dependencies.ref: VS-C R3 Task A/Task B environment and learner semantics
single learner identity and uninterrupted optimizer state across interleaved updates
both R3-compatible per-task aggregate gates at final checkpoint

parent_authority.interpretation: R3 joint means joint adjudication of separate task-specific training instances; it does not establish this R0 composition claim.

task_a.name: ACCOUNT_CONDITIONED_MAINTENANCE_JOINT_CONFIRMATION
task_a.market: identical flat OHLCV: prices 100, volume 10, one predecessor plus 64 represented bars
task_a.positive_training_observation: policy observes the true AccountState derived from each actual AccountTruth

control.name: ACCOUNT_OBSERVATION_ZERO_RELATION
control.construction: every actual-account x observed-account pair appears equally; actual and observed account marginals are balanced and exactly independent
control.reward_physics: reward always comes from actual AccountTruth and sampled action; only policy-observed AccountState is zero-relation

task_b.name: DELAYED_CONSEQUENCE_CREDIT

cue_market.up: represented closes rise exponentially from 100*exp(-0.04) to 100
cue_market.down: represented closes fall exponentially from 100*exp(+0.04) to 100
cue_market.open: previous represented close; first represented open equals predecessor close

step_1.market: neutral flat OHLCV at price 100 and volume 10
step_1.description: the position created by action_0 remains active through the gap before action_1 executes; with zero friction and close_2=open_2, action_1 has no contemporaneous economic effect

task_b.positive_training: use each trajectory's own delayed step_1 log-equity reward

control.name: SHUFFLED_ACTION_TO_CONSEQUENCE
control.construction: within every generation, preserve all collected states/actions and the multiset of delayed step_1 rewards, but assign delayed rewards through a deterministic seed-and-generation-specific non-identity permutation before learner update

training_schedule.learner_generation_id: global monotonic 0..511; Task A update in cycle c consumes generation 2c and Task B update consumes generation 2c+1
training_schedule.task_local_generation_index: cycle index 0..255 is used for the inherited R3 task-specific collection RNG and Task-B shuffled-consequence permutation RNG; this preserves the parent per-task RNG semantics while the learner generation remains global

reused_r3_final_gates.evaluation_checkpoint: AFTER_FINAL_TASK_B_UPDATE for both Task A and Task B; PRE-to-POST improvements are PRE -> AFTER_FINAL_TASK_B_UPDATE

composition_gate.joint_seed_definition: a seed is joint-pass at a checkpoint iff the same learner checkpoint passes both inherited R3 per-seed Task A and Task B gates
